commodity_group.linkage: Joint outputs from imported soybean crushing; distinct demand and stocks

hypothesis: Seasonally unusual meal inventory coverage may precede meal supply tightness.
mechanism: Fewer weeks of same-sample inventory relative to disappearance can constrain near-term deliveries.
counterexample: Stock coverage falls because sample firms exit, feed demand collapses, or inventories move downstream; no genuine tightness.

evidence.excerpt: No empirical evidence supplied. Mechanism is an unvalidated research hypothesis.
evidence.contradicts: Stock coverage falls because sample firms exit, feed demand collapses, or inventories move downstream; no genuine tightness.

expected_direction: positive value -> higher meal return, conditional and unvalidated

target.return: external 14-day real-contract return; meal only for coverage, separate meal/oil for others
target.physical: Compare next released meal stock/disappearance and delivery shortfalls; distinguish survey coverage changes.

availability_rules: Latest eligible source vintage; exact next-14-day forecast targets; observed publications required for verified PIT.

parameters.seasonal_calendar: calendar_month illustrative only; China/Lunar New Year alignment requires reviewed operator

normalization: Training-cutoff eligible prior calendar-month years, equal year weighting
missing_stale_policy: BLOCKED_DATA; no backfill; bounded forward use only after release
failure_conditions: Stock coverage falls because sample firms exit, feed demand collapses, or inventories move downstream; no genuine tightness.
